##### ClinVar's source for functional assay terms is the Experimental Factors Ontology, which includes terms from other ontologies like the Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI).

##### Not all terms from EFO are used by ClinVar for assay type. Contact us at clinvar@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov to discuss allowing a new EFO term in ClinVar or adding new term to EFO to support ClinVar submissions.

#### EFO terms that ClinVar uses for assay type are listed below.

EFO term	EFO ID
DNA binding assay	EFO:0022951
RNAseq	EFO:0008896
RT-PCR	OBI:0000552
Western blotting	EFO:0022945
animal model	EFO:0022953
cellular survival assay	EFO:0022952
enzyme assay	EFO:0022947
flow cytometry assay	OBI_0000916
fluorescence microscopy	FBbi:00000246
immunocytochemistry	OBI_0002174
immunofluorescence assay	EFO:0022944
immunohistochemistry	EFO:0022943
in vitro motility assay	EFO:0022946
minigene splicing assay	EFO:0022942
patch clamp	EFO:0022948
promoter activity assay	EFO:0022950
protein binding measurement	EFO:0010742
single-cell RNA sequencing	EFO:0008913
subcellular protein localization assay	EFO:0022949
two electrode voltage clamp assay	OBI:0002183
